question: Show all invoice status codes and details and the corresponding client id and details and agency id and details.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "agencies" AS SELECT "ag_id" AS "ag_id", "qymx" AS "qymx" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "client_agency_attributes" AS SELECT "client_id" AS "client_id", "agency_id" AS "agency_id", "attribute" AS "attribute", "value" AS "value" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "invoices" AS SELECT "invoice_id" AS "invoice_id", "client_id" AS "client_id", "invoice_details_finish" AS "invoice_details_finish", "invoice_details_starting" AS "invoice_details_starting", "invoice_details_working" AS "invoice_details_working" FROM table_3;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH unpivoted AS (
    SELECT i.invoice_id,
           i.client_id,
           'finish' AS status_code,
           NULLIF(TRIM(i.invoice_details_finish), '') AS status_detail
    FROM invoices i
    UNION ALL
    SELECT i.invoice_id,
           i.client_id,
           'starting' AS status_code,
           NULLIF(TRIM(i.invoice_details_starting), '') AS status_detail
    FROM invoices i
    UNION ALL
    SELECT i.invoice_id,
           i.client_id,
           'working' AS status_code,
           NULLIF(TRIM(i.invoice_details_working), '') AS status_detail
    FROM invoices i
), filtered AS (
    SELECT * FROM unpivoted WHERE status_detail IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(status_detail) <> 'nan'
), client_agency AS (
    SELECT client_id, MIN(agency_id) AS agency_id
    FROM client_agency_attributes
    GROUP BY client_id
), client_details_raw AS (
    SELECT client_id, LIST(DISTINCT value) AS client_details_list
    FROM client_agency_attributes
    WHERE LOWER(attribute) LIKE '%client%'
    GROUP BY client_id
), agency_details_attr AS (
    SELECT agency_id, LIST(DISTINCT value) AS agency_details_list
    FROM client_agency_attributes
    WHERE LOWER(attribute) LIKE '%agency%'
    GROUP BY agency_id
), agency_master AS (
    SELECT ag_id AS agency_id, qymx AS agency_master_detail
    FROM agencies
), agency_details_final AS (
    SELECT u.agency_id,
           COALESCE(
               array_join(ada.agency_details_list, '; '),
               am.agency_master_detail,
               ''
           ) AS agency_details
    FROM (
        SELECT agency_id FROM client_agency
        UNION
        SELECT agency_id FROM agency_details_attr
        UNION
        SELECT agency_id FROM agency_master
    ) u
    LEFT JOIN agency_details_attr ada ON ada.agency_id = u.agency_id
    LEFT JOIN agency_master am ON am.agency_id = u.agency_id
)
SELECT f.status_code,
       f.status_detail,
       f.client_id,
       ca.agency_id,
       COALESCE(array_join(cdr.client_details_list, '; '), '') AS client_details,
       ad.agency_details
FROM filtered f
LEFT JOIN client_agency ca ON ca.client_id = f.client_id
LEFT JOIN client_details_raw cdr ON cdr.client_id = f.client_id
LEFT JOIN agency_details_final ad ON ad.agency_id = ca.agency_id
ORDER BY f.status_code, f.client_id, f.status_detail
